items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: We all belong to the same club, the Friendly Fifty. ... Call up Stanley Dance, see if he's (unintelligible) work tonight. He was working down at the post office, worked in the band. We'd call him, got a gig for tomorrow night.

ctx.x: The -- I think what it is, Stanley, is that the construction of the instrument is different because

everything -- once you get the swing of it, you can find so many funny notes you want to make. Not only lipping (unintelligible) but the Johnny Dodds fingering too -- I used to make a whole lot like tiny dots.
